### Courses

#### [Fusion and industrial plasma technologies](https://edu.epfl.ch/coursebook/en/fusion-and-industrial-plasma-technologies-PHYS-632)

PHYS-632

The course provides an overview of the technologies that are essential for fusion developments and for industrial plasma
applications, highlighting the synergies between the two fields. The aim is to provide a combined theoretical and
experimental background to the various topics.

#### [General physics : mechanics](https://edu.epfl.ch/coursebook/en/general-physics-mechanics-PHYS-101-A)

PHYS-101(a)

Give the student the basic notions that will allow him or her to have a better understanding of physical phenomena, such as the mechanic of point masses. Acquire the capacity to analyse quantitatively the consequences of these effects with appropriate theoretical tools.

### Cours

#### [Fusion and industrial plasma technologies](https://edu.epfl.ch/coursebook/fr/fusion-and-industrial-plasma-technologies-PHYS-632)

PHYS-632

The course provides an overview of the technologies that are essential for fusion developments and for industrial plasma applications, highlighting the synergies between the two fields. The aim is to provide a combined theoretical and experimental background to the various topics.

#### [Physique générale : mécanique](https://edu.epfl.ch/coursebook/fr/physique-generale-mecanique-PHYS-101-A)

PHYS-101(a)

Le but du cours de physique générale est de donner à l'étudiant les notions de base nécessaires à la compréhension des phénomènes physiques. L'objectif est atteint lorsque l'étudiant est capable de prévoir quantitativement les conséquences de ces phénomènes avec des outils théoriques appropriés.
